reason: One search for a Three Musketeers Ridge scramble from Snow/Nada Lakes. The only description found places the ridge on the way to Toketie Pass as part of the Edwards Mesa traverse, and it is a Mountaineers page (403). The opened countryhighpoints Enchantments page does not cover it. No route description, timing or gain for the ridge itself. Row issue: the id says big_chiwaukum, but the approach (Snow Lakes, Nada Lake) and the Toketie context put the ridge in the Enchantments, not the Chiwaukums.

Two searches. The only 'Northwest Chimney Route' found on Mountain Project, once opened, is on Montezuma's Head in Arizona, not Cascade Peak. Other results cover Mixup Peak and the C-J couloir, plus a 1962 AAJ note on Cascade Peak's history. No source describes a northwest chimney on Cascade Peak.

Three searches. The only route-specific source is an OpenBeta mirror of the Mountain Project listing (FA Childs/Goldie 2000, 5.8 IV solo, up to 5.9+ V roped). It returned 404 when opened, and the Mountain Project page itself did not come up. SummitPost (403) has only grade notes. No opened source gives days, hours or distances for the Cedar Creek line. Possible row issue: the row's grade-IV/V ridge is listed with pitches 0 and a 3.5-mile crest, and the snippets suggest a much longer, committing day.

One search. The only route-specific result is a 2004 CascadeClimbers inquiry thread (403), which says few parties climb it. No opened source describes the route, timing or camps. Row issue: the id says glacier_peak, but the peak is Mount Rainier.

Two searches. Nothing describes a route called Tahoma Cleaver on Rainier. Results cover Success Cleaver, the Tahoma Glacier and the DC. The only mention is the Mountaineers Glacier Island Traverse page (403 domain, seen only as a snippet), which reaches the cleaver's base at about 8,100 ft. Row issue: the id says glacier_peak, but the peak is Mount Rainier.

One search, three pages opened. The Mountain Project page describes the headwall (Grade II, 2,000 ft, Riley trailhead, descend the West Ridge) but gives no times, distances or camps. The Oregon Hikers report follows the same Riley Creek approach only to the moraine lakes, as a day hike; it does not climb the headwall. The turns-all-year report saw the headwall from above and skied the west ridge instead. That leaves one source for the climb itself and no stated hours.

One search, two pages opened. climberkyle climbed Switchback's southeast ridge from Crater Creek via Cooney Lake. yellowleaf went from Martin Creek via Cooney Lake and passed Boiling Lake only on day 2. Neither describes the west ridge or west face from Boiling Lake. The Mountaineers route page that does describe it is 403 (snippet only).

One search, two pages opened. The detailed South Face reports (approach of about 6 to 7 hours up Ingalls and Crystal Creeks, a tarn camp, 3 pitches) are all SummitPost pages (403). Lemke's page has only the summit date and grade. The Wenatchee Outdoors page is a ski tour from the Enchantments side and says the south side is for climbers only. No second openable source.
